findings.title: Running the persona suite turns the eslint gate red with 1124 errors in generated output
findings.observed: After `npx playwright test -c tests/e2e-harness/playwright.personas.config.ts`, the gate-run block reports `4 eslint exit 1 FAIL 1124 errors, 378 warnings`. All 1124 are in `playwright-report/personas/trace/**` — Playwright's own bundled report viewer (`codeMirrorModule`, `sw.bundle.js`, etc). Deleting the directory returns the gate to `exit 0 PASS, 0 errors, 378 warnings`.
findings.expected: eslint ignores generated, gitignored output. `dist-e2e` is in both .gitignore and eslint's ignores; `playwright-report` and `test-results` are in .gitignore only.
findings.reproduction: npx playwright test -c tests/e2e-harness/playwright.personas.config.ts ; python3 .claude/skills/gate-run/scripts/gates.py ; rm -rf playwright-report test-results ; python3 .claude/skills/gate-run/scripts/gates.py
findings.consequence: Every agent that runs the persona suite and then runs the gates — which is the prescribed order for any e2e task — gets a red lint gate caused entirely by test-report artifacts. It cost this run a turn to diagnose, and the failure mode invites either a false 'the branch broke lint' report or a habit of ignoring gate 4. The fix is adding two entries to the ignores array.
findings.notClaimed: Not a defect in any shipped product surface, and it does not affect CI if CI lints a fresh checkout. I did not check whether the CI lint job runs after any Playwright job. `eslint.config.js` was outside this task's Allowed Files, so it was deliberately not changed.
